t: This is Spitfire Audio, an English music technology company based in London. It makes virtual instrument sample libraries, which composers use to produce music. It was founded in 2007 by two professional composers, Christian Henson and Paul Thomson. Henson works mainly on television and film soundtracks and has been nominated for a BAFTA and an Ivor Novello Award. Thomson composes for film, television and video games, and won a Royal Television Society award in 2012 for his theme music for the BBC show The Fades.
